about.title: Unified AI Gateway Engine
about.desc: LLMux is a professional-grade multi-account gateway designed for local access to all your favorite LLMs.

features.speedDesc: Zero overhead local proxying. Your models, your speed, no middleman latency.
features.privacyDesc: Local data storage. We never transmit your sensitive keys to any external servers.
features.agnosticDesc: Native support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and custom endpoints.
features.multiDesc: Switch between multiple accounts and API providers seamlessly.

about.madeWith: Made with heart by LLMux Team

accounts.title: Account Management
accounts.subtitle: Securely manage your AI provider API Keys locally.
accounts.addFirst: Click the button above to add your first AI provider key.
accounts.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete account "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone!
accounts.deleteWarning: Warning: This action will erase all traces of this account from the system.
accounts.deleteWarningDetail: Note: If an alias is configured for this account, please delete it manually from the provider console. Once confirmed, all records in the local database will be permanently wiped and cannot be recovered.
accounts.keyEncrypted: Your keys are encrypted locally and never leave your device.
accounts.providerHint: The gateway routes by account type and converts between Anthropic / OpenAI protocols automatically.
accounts.supportsAnthropicHint: When enabled, this account can receive Anthropic protocol requests. Falls back to Base URL if Anthropic Base URL is empty.
accounts.baseUrlHint: Leave empty to use the default. The gateway converts the request to the target protocol and patches the model name and auth header.
accounts.skipValidationHint: Some third-party APIs don't implement the /models endpoint. When checked: models are fetched if available, but an empty result won't block account creation.
accounts.validationFailed: Validation failed: Could not fetch any models from this account. Please check your API Key and Base URL.

setup.title: Quick Setup
setup.subtitle: Pick your tool and API key, then copy the config to connect to the LLMux gateway.
setup.notInstalledHint: {{tool}} is not detected. Please install it before using this config.
setup.modelRolesHint: Map aliases to Opus/Sonnet/Haiku roles; aliases resolve to the actual model before forwarding to the provider.
setup.endpointHint: Claude Code talks to the gateway via /v1/messages (Anthropic protocol); the gateway authenticates, converts, and routes to the upstream.
setup.codexModelRolesHint: Select the default model for Codex. Communicates with gateway over OpenAI protocol.
setup.codexEndpointHint: Codex communicates via /v1 (OpenAI protocol); the gateway authenticates and routes to the target model. Ensure your account supports the responses API; otherwise, use an older Codex version with chat mode.
setup.wireApiHint: responses = new Responses API (Codex native); chat = classic Chat Completions (best compatibility). Switch to chat if you get errors.
setup.contextWindowHint: Max context length for the model. Leave empty to keep current. Usually 1000000.
setup.autoCompactLimitHint: Auto-compact conversation at this token count. Leave empty to keep current. Usually 90% of context.
setup.geminiModelHint: Select the default model for Gemini CLI.
setup.geminiEndpointHint: Gemini CLI communicates via /v1beta (Gemini protocol); the gateway authenticates and routes to the target model.
setup.noSettingsHint: Click the button above to initialize
setup.deleteBackupConfirm: Delete backup {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
setup.dirtyConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Restoring a backup will discard them. Continue?
